title: Bump a dependency within its major version

params.name: package
params.description: The dependency to update, as declared in a package.json.

preconditions: The package is declared in dependencies, devDependencies, or optionalDependencies of a package.json.
A committed lockfile (pnpm, npm, yarn, or bun).
Dependencies are installed locally so build and test scripts can run.

criteria.pass: The lockfile changed for the package, its major version (minor for 0.x) is unchanged, no other dependency changed, and the build and test scripts pass.
criteria.partial: The package was updated within its major version, but the build or tests fail, or other dependencies changed.
criteria.fail: The lockfile was not updated for the package, the package was removed, or its major version changed.
